Reviewed the complete claim, sole ordinary implementation association (sage_ir::symbol), full symbol/mod.rs, and sole associated TODO test sage_meta::todo::symbols_definition_identity. Requirements are (1) names/paths/scopes/namespaces discover definitions while downstream semantic references retain Symbol, and (2) import aliases or alternative paths to one definition preserve identity. The macro-generated Symbol stores local semantic handles or SymExt, derives equality/hash from that data, and its conversions preserve the supplied handle; neither lookup spelling nor path is stored in the wrapper identity. SymExt carries crate/definition/kind fields. named_children filters lookup name and namespace, then constructs symbols from metadata definition fields. This supports the representation design without establishing all resolver/downstream behavior. Reflection keys likewise use symbol family and handle id, not names. No additional helper implementation is relied upon to assert full resolution correctness.

The complete associated test is an empty TODO with no assertions. Its explicit distinct-path/same-symbol and equal-spelling/different-scope resolution matrix covers the outstanding identity validation, including renamed imports and alternative paths; output examples are expressly insufficient. Prerequisite to closing this deferral is a resolution fixture exposing actual resulting symbols, with identity equality assertions for aliases/alternate paths and inequality for distinct definitions with equal spelling, also inspecting downstream retained symbols. The current placeholder cannot catch alias-dependent identity or name-based conflation. This is accepted existing verification debt, not proof that every successful reference satisfies the claim. No N/A entries exist and no additional edits are required to this explicit accounting.

Baseline: independently compared current implementation and test files byte-for-byte to historical implementation_sources/test_sources; both exactly match. Reassessed the historical rationale against the current complete claim and associations rather than treating its outcome as approval. Source review and exact comparisons only; personally executed review start/read and record, no behavioral tests or build. Coordinator-reported 321 sage-meta tests and cargo build are separate baseline execution, not my execution or identity coverage.
